about.title: The Largest International Horticultural Expo in Southeast Asia
about.description: The Udon Thani International Horticultural Expo 2026 is a world-class horticultural exhibition endorsed by the International Association of Horticultural Producers (AIPH). This event will showcase the beauty of flora from around the globe, along with cutting-edge innovations in agriculture and environmental sustainability.

gallery.title: The Beauty of World Horticulture
gallery.desc: View the atmosphere and garden designs from world-class horticultural events
